product.title: Cortech Summit Compact Stool - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 330
product.body_html:
The Cortech Summit Stool delivers compact, molded seating with optional soft-touch comfort for behavioral health spaces. Durable, easy to clean, and designed for flexible layouts. Calming design, safe edges, and easy cleanability for high-use spaces. Designed to stand alone or be arranged in groups.

  • Durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for maximum strength. Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene. No steel or wood components
  • Residential-inspired form for therapeutic environments
  • Rounded edges and smooth surfaces enhance safety
  • Options:
    • Available in Veldura version with soft-touch exterior (order style 331)
    • Model 330S has a ballast door that secures with tamper-resistant screws and can be used to add sandbags on-site (loose sand not recommended)
    • Factory weighting available
  • Inherently antimicrobial and easy to clean
  • Sound dampening
  • One-piece molded frame with no metal or wood components
  • Dimensions: 18"H x 20"W x 21"D
  • Flame retardant (passes UL 94 HB)
  • GREENGUARD Gold Certified for low chemical emissions
  • Lifetime Warranty
  • Made in the USA to ISO Quality Standards
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, Tide

The Summit Stool provides a compact, supportive seating option for behavioral health and other secure environments. Its simple form and softened geometry help maintain a calm, residential feel while supporting a wide range of room layouts. Because of its smaller footprint, the Cortech Summit Stool works well in patient rooms, dayrooms, group spaces, and shared areas where flexibility is important.

The molded construction eliminates seams and joints that could be tampered with, supporting safety in high-acuity settings. The stool can be specified with a Veldura soft-touch surface, which adds comfort and a warm tactile experience without sacrificing durability. In addition, the Summit Stool can be factory weighted or filled on site using approved material. Loose sand should not be used. This added weight improves stability during daily use.

The Summit Stool coordinates with other Cortech Summit seating and tables, allowing facilities to create cohesive, human-centered environments. Its cleanability, strength, and calming design make it a dependable choice for spaces that support healing and safety.

About Cortech Summit Furniture:
The Cortech Summit Series intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Cortech Summit Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
